fact: In its initial report to the UN CRPD Committee (received 5 December 2024, issued 8 October 2025), Guinea-Bissau states it has no specific legislation on priority service for persons with disabilities and none on sign language, while its National Strategy for the Inclusion of People with Disabilities provides for developing and implementing public accessibility policies including access to information.
title: Initial report submitted by Guinea-Bissau under article 35 of the Convention, due in 2016 (CRPD/C/GNB/1)
publisher: United Nations, Committee on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
